the decrease of the serum levels of retinol and ascorbate, but not of carotenoids and tocopherols, may be considered as a possible risk factor for the development of benign and malignant breast neoplasias.

the decrease of serum retinol and carotene values is more pronounced in patients with breast neoplastic diseases, while tocopherol and vitamin C are significantly lower in patients with breast carcinoma.
